why: llama-cvector-generator writes unit-norm directions per layer, so the spec's scales 0.25 / 0.5 / 1.0 are relative: applied scale = relative x unit. The unit is the largest scale that kept keep96's output coherent with the vector on all layers, on one toy fix prompt (no task scoring).
pairs: 201 same-prompt pairs from the calibration pool's rows (steer.py make_pairs)
